summary: Iteration 3 full regression passed. Backend: 23/23 pytest including new GET /api/ice-config (auth-required + STUN list). Frontend: login as Alice, dashboard shows partner Bob + watchlist, Add-to-watchlist dialog opens, navigate to Watch Room, all controls present (screen-share, video-call, voice-call, sync-play, sync-pause, back, chat toggle), ICE config fetched from /api/ice-config returns 5 STUN servers, chat send via BUTTON CLICK works end-to-end (iter-2 critical bug verified FIXED), chat send via Enter key works, read-receipt check icons render on sent messages (7 receipt elements after sending), emoji picker opens with both Emojis and Stickers tabs, back-to-dashboard nav works, logout redirects to /login.

issues: Partner 'Offline' badge low contrast on pastel bg (carry-over from iter 1, non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: Chat.js input row now uses `pb-14` which reserves bottom-right safe-area for the fixed Emergent badge; iter-2 chat-send-button overlap is resolved.
Backend /api/ice-config correctly gates on auth (401 without token) and appends TURN server only if TURN_URL/TURN_USERNAME/TURN_CREDENTIAL env vars are all set (currently STUN-only - expected).
WatchRoom.js fetches ICE config in a dedicated useEffect and falls back to hard-coded STUN list on failure - good.
WatchRoom.js is ~688 lines - should be split into useWatchRoomRTC + useWatchRoomSocket hooks for maintainability (non-blocking).
Chrome extension at /app/chrome-extension/ not testable via Playwright (requires manual chrome --load-extension); recommend a short manual QA pass before release.
